roleContext.jobDescription: Copperline Kitchens operates 110 casual-dining restaurants. The Project Manager for restaurant technology plans and runs rollouts of kitchen and front-of-house systems, manages vendors and installation partners against contract milestones, designs site trials, and delivers rollouts into live trading across many sites, including go-live sign-off with each general manager and a hypercare period. A recognised project-management certification is required. Restaurants are run by general managers who sign off each go-live, and the project manager works with the operations director, the IT team and franchise partners. A new kitchen ordering system and handheld ordering devices are planned for next year.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Project Manager, Restaurant Technology

## Experience

- Project Coordinator, Bramble & Barrow Pubs, April 2022 to July 2024. Built the schedule and RAID log for the kitchen display screen project and updated both after each weekly vendor call, sending the RAID log to the operations director each Friday.
- Tracked the screen vendor and the installation partner against the contract milestones, chasing two late hardware deliveries and recording the recovery dates agreed.
- Set up a ten-week trial of kitchen display screens in three pubs, with the screens used alongside paper tickets during quieter weekday services while weekend services stayed on paper only.
- Gathered cooks' and managers' feedback from the trial pubs through a short weekly form and summarised it for the operations director, grouping comments by kitchen station.
- Wrote the trial close report, setting out the screen-layout changes needed before any wider rollout, with costs for the hardware changes.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the trial plan for the kitchen display screens, naming the three trial pubs, the ten-week schedule, the weekday-only usage rule, the success measures and the criteria the operations director would use to decide on a wider rollout, signed by the operations director.
